title: Gamma-Ray Bursts
description: For a few seconds, the brightest light in the Universe: a jet from a newborn black hole at nearly the speed of light, beamed straight at us. Unlocks the Burst Observatory.

puzzle.goal: A jet moving at speed v beams its light forward into a narrow cone. Write the half-angle θ of the cone, with the speed of light c.
puzzle.name: Relativistic beaming angle
puzzle.ask: Find θ in degrees for a jet with b = 0.9999944 (its speed as a fraction of c, a Lorentz factor of 300).
puzzle.method: Aberration: light emitted at right angles in the jet's frame comes out at sin θ = 1/γ = √(1 − v²/c²) in ours.
